capabilities: Manage novel projects with separate modules for characters, foreshadowing, worldbuilding, and chapter outlines
Generate chapters with AI in generate, continue, rewrite, expand, and brainstorm modes
Review chapters for contradictions with earlier chapters and AI-generated traces
Track token usage and per-model writing costs with configurable rates
Upload reference files to a knowledge base and extract writing knowledge with AI
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README is duplicated in English and Chinese.MIT-licensed.
motivation: The author built it around human-AI collaboration because pure AI novels suffer from AI-flavored prose, long-form collapse after 100 chapters, and copyright risk.
problem: Obsidian has no structured workflow for long-form fiction, where AI can help draft and expand chapters while tracking characters, foreshadowing, and cross-chapter consistency.

relations.evidence: Multi-provider AI support: OpenAI, Anthropic, custom API
Multi-provider AI support: OpenAI, Anthropic, custom API

requires.name: OpenAI, Anthropic, or custom-compatible API key

summary: AI-assisted novel-writing workbench that manages characters, foreshadowing, worldbuilding, and outlines, and generates and reviews chapters with AI.
